newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's ICA Q2 net rises to 178 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's ICA Q2 net rises to 178 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexico's Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora SA's second-quarter net profit rose to 178 million pesos from 164 million pesos in the year-ago period, the company said on Monday.
The construction group, known as ICA, said earnings per share rose to 1.69 pesos from 1.56 pesos.
Earnings were boosted by profits of 267 million pesos from the sale of the company's stake in Mexpetrol.
Revenues rose 3.6 percent year on year to 2.08 billion pesos, "principally because of greater sales in urban construction, real estate development and hotels."
ICA said it generated $94 million in projects in foreign currencies, about 36 percent of its total revenue, down from $132 million, or 60 percent, in the year-ago period.
Sales costs fell by six percent to 1.623 billion pesos, raising the gross margin to 22.1 percent.
Operating expenses rose 60 percent. Still, the operating margin rose to 6.8 percent compared with 4.2 percent in the year-ago second quarter, ICA said.
Losses from some highway interests were partially compensated by profits from the Veracruz port concession, the builder said.
